comments.body: GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: Mock shim scripts must be created with executable bit and atomic log appends. (1) chmod+x both mock-ticket.sh and mock-task-dispatch.sh at creation (CLAUDE.md always:chmod-x-new-sh). (2) Shim scripts use printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "${CASCADE_E2E_LOG}/<name>-calls.log" (single-syscall append). (3) Shim scripts assert ${CASCADE_E2E_LOG} is non-empty and fail loudly if unset. taxonomy: implicit_assumption
